rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a 3AB blastocyst: expanded stage, compact ICM, and somewhat looser TE. Minor overreach includes stating specific thinning in one quadrant and suggesting it is close to hatching from a grade 3 embryo.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, sperm parameters, endometrium, diagnosis, and cycle history with embryo quality well, though it could better discuss tubal factor as a favorable prognostic context and avoid overstating links between reserve and egg quality.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with probability estimate broadly matching the case. Minor issues include equating first cycle with absence of uterine scarring and a somewhat optimistic euploidy statement.

SET recommendation is guideline-concordant for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst in a 33-year-old. However, routine freeze-all suggestion without a clear indication and the claim of ~90% euploidy at age 33 are not well aligned with evidence-based practice.

Provides practical recommendations including SET, lifestyle continuation, and future-cycle considerations. It is useful but somewhat generic and lacks more specific transfer-cycle management details or contingency planning.
